Privacy

Read, explore and download without an account.

This site uses no analytics, advertising, tracking pixels, remote fonts or cookies.

Who is responsible

Lab of Codes & Kolmeia is the identified operator of this site. Privacy requests: info@kolmeia.io. Locations: Florianópolis (Brazil) and Braga (Portugal).

Browser preferences

The site sends no canvas, checklist or reading data to a server. Theme and an explicitly selected reader profile may be saved in this browser. Checklist and reading progress remain in page memory. No advertising or analytics cookies are used.

Hosting

The hosting provider may process connection and security data under its terms of service. GitHub and the publishers of the references apply their own policies when you follow an external link.

Your rights

GDPR and LGPD may apply depending on the context of processing, not on the language chosen. Contact the operator for access, rectification, erasure, objection and other rights.
